show_app_name.label: Show application name
show_app_name.description: Show the focused application's name in front of its menus.

shortcut_menus.label: Shortcut menus
shortcut_menus.description: Show curated menus for applications that export none. Clicking an item sends its keyboard shortcut to the window (needs wtype).

fallback_menus.label: Fallback menus
fallback_menus.description: Show window and session actions when the application exports no menu at all.

max_menus.label: Menu labels in the bar
max_menus.description: Maximum top-level menu labels shown before truncation; 0 shows every menu.

bar_max_width.label: Menu bar width budget
bar_max_width.description: Maximum width in px for the app name and menu labels before the rest moves under the » button; 0 fits to half of the screen width.
